ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a thermodynamic data table, with columns H2(g), Cl2(g), HCl(g). The table gives ΔfH°(298.15 K)/kJ·mol^-1: H2 is 0, Cl2 is 0, HCl is -92.31; Sm°(298.15 K)/J·mol^-1·K^-1: H2 is 130.6, Cl2 is 223.0, HCl is 186.8; ΔfG°(298.15 K)/kJ·mol^-1: H2 is 0, Cl2 is 0, HCl is -95.30. Then reason: for the reaction H2(g)+Cl2(g)=2HCl(g), from the enthalpy of formation, ΔrH°=2×(-92.31)-0-0=-184.62 kJ·mol^-1. From the standard entropy, ΔrS°=2×186.8-130.6-223.0=20.0 J·mol^-1·K^-1=0.0200 kJ·mol^-1·K^-1. At 500 K, ΔrG°=ΔrH°-TΔrS°=-184.62-500×0.0200=-194.62 kJ·mol^-1; according to the standard answer, fill in its numerical magnitude as 194.62. From ln Kp°=-ΔrG°/(RT), taking R=8.314 J·mol^-1·K^-1, T=500 K, obtain ln Kp°=194620/(8.314×500)≈46.8, therefore Kp°≈10^20.

raw_record.question_text: Given the information shown in the figure, at a temperature of 500K, find the standard molar Gibbs function change $\Delta G^\circ$ (unit: kJ·mol$^{-1}$) and the standard equilibrium constant $K_p^\circ$ for the reaction $H_2(g) + Cl_2(g) = 2HCl(g)$.

method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：附图是一个热力学数据表，列为 H2(g)、Cl2(g)、HCl(g)。表中给出 298.15 K 下的标准生成焓 ΔfH°：H2 为 0，Cl2 为 0，HCl 为 -92.31 kJ·mol^-1；标准摩尔熵 S°：H2 为 130.6，Cl2 为 223.0，HCl 为 186.8 J·mol^-1·K^-1；标准生成吉布斯函数 ΔfG°：H2 为 0，Cl2 为 0，HCl 为 -95.30 kJ·mol^-1。再推理：对反应 H2(g)+Cl2(g)=2HCl(g)，由生成焓计算 ΔrH°=2×(-92.31)-0-0=-184.62 kJ·mol^-1。由标准熵计算 ΔrS°=2×186.8-130.6-223.0=20.0 J·mol^-1·K^-1=0.0200 kJ·mol^-1·K^-1。在 500 K 下，ΔrG°=ΔrH°-TΔrS°=-184.62-500×0.0200=-194.62 kJ·mol^-1。若按题目答案只填写数值大小，则为 194.62。平衡常数满足 ln Kp°=-ΔrG°/(RT)，取 R=8.314 J·mol^-1·K^-1，T=500 K，得 ln Kp°=194620/(8.314×500)≈46.8，因此 Kp°≈e^46.8≈10^20。
